title: Logo
description: Your logo appears on carrier booking pages, in emails and in the driver app.
current_description: Carriers and drivers see this logo next to your company name.
none: No logo yet. Carriers and drivers see your company name only.
delete_description: Carrier pages, emails and the driver app show your company name without a logo.
hint: PNG or JPEG, up to 256 KB. A wide logo on a transparent or white background works best.
wrong_type: Choose a PNG or JPEG image. Other formats such as SVG are not accepted.
too_big: The image is larger than 256 KB. Choose a smaller file.
